app_release_notes: v1.6.2 - Seating numbers now carry the right label. When you plan a seating ladder in the New Ladder wizard you are varying your jump off the lands, not a CBTO measurement -- but Share a load, the printed Load Card, Compare Loads and the Library detail all called it 'CBTO'. The number never changed; now the label matches it.
